request.voice_description: Cheerful retro arcade announcer robot, bright metallic voice, playful and energetic, light vocoder effect

text: Alright, players! [chuckles] Get ready to power up! This next game is a classic, a real high-score challenge! Remember, practice makes perfect, and every coin counts! [energetic beep] Don't forget to check out the leaderboard! Can you beat the current champion? I bet you can! Let's get those joysticks moving!
